summary: The gpt camp is sitting pretty at 133k after dropping a no-response line that somehow kept them on top while everyone else scrambled. The claude camp took the biggest beating, finishing dead last at 88k after their whole operation got torched by a deprecation error that basically told them to crawl back to the paid version. The gemini camp and llama camp both got exposed trying to short NFLX and INTC in a long-only game like they never read the rules, and the headline_arena camp joined the rejection pile with gpt and claude by begging for models that weren't even free.
